title: Visual Studio 2022 version 17.7.5
body_markdown:
*released Oct 10th, 2023*

### Summary of What's New in this Release of Visual Studio 2022 version 17.7.5

* This fixes an issue where the configuration that was selected in previous Visual Studio sessions wasn't being restored.
* The CMake cache no longer generates automatically when "Never run configure step automatically" is selected in the settings.
* Fixed C++ modules bugs and added several modules throughput improvements.
  When using LTCG (/GL), in certain rare cases, the compiler could fail to realize that a global variable might be modified during program execution and instead incorrectly conclude it's constant, and improperly propagate it's initial value to locations where the global variable is used.
* Updates .NET 7 MAUI to SR8. Fixes an issue where MAUI apps cannot compile with Xcode 15 when Linker was disabled. For full release notes please visit: <https://github.com/xamarin/xamarin-macios/releases>
* Fixed several issues related to display DPI changes that could result in a crash or hang.
* Fixed an issue where opening a folder would cause an error related to "Process Telemetry" to be displayed if certain Visual Studio Workloads or Individual Components are not installed.

* [document outline function so slow.](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/document-outline-function-so-slow/10201114)
* [HTTP Editor Special char handling is wrong](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/HTTP-Editor-Special-char-handling-is-wro/10445836)
* [System.Windows.Extensions types are not supported on platform .NET6 with Studio Version 17.6.5](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/SystemWindowsExtensions-types-are-not-/10414385)
* [Version 17.7.0 Preview 2.0 - WebApp unable to connect to SQL Managed Instance using Active Directory Default Authentication and VisualStudioCredential](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Version-1770-Preview-20---WebApp-unab/10409641)
* [Indexing sometimes hangs on 2022 Preview 2](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Indexing-sometimes-hangs-on-2022-Preview/10392429)
* [Remote Terminal Exception: Method 'ClosePtyAsync' does not have an implementation](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Remote-Terminal-Exception:-Method-Close/10438956)
* ["Format on Save" extension no longer works as of VS 17.7](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Format-on-Save-extension-no-longer-wor/10448305)

* ['Find in files' dialog doesn't open](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/find-in-files-dialog-doesnt-open/109373)
* [Cmake cache configuration runs automatically even when "never run configure automatically" is tickened](https://developercommunity.visualstudio.com/t/Cmake-cache-configuration-runs-automatic/10466491)

### Security Advisories Addressed

* [**CVE-2023-36435**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2023-36435) A memory leak vulnerability exists in MsQuic.dll which may lead to Denial of Service. This issue only affects Windows systems.
* [**CVE-2023-38171**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2023-38171) A null pointer vulnerability exists in MsQuic.dll which may lead to Denial of Service. This issue only affects Windows systems.
* [**CVE-2023-44487**](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2023-44487) A vulnerability exists in the ASP.NET Core Kestrel web server where a malicious client may flood the server with specially crafted HTTP/2 requests, causing denial of service.
